description: Nvidia is obviously in the news constantly because of the AI boom — but it's also a major supplier to the entire auto industry As head of Nvidia's automotive division, Xinzhou Wu has a front-row seat to all the challenges EVs and autonomous vehicles are facing, especially in the US. And of course, you can’t talk about electric cars or vehicle autonomy in the US without talking about Elon Musk and Tesla. So I asked Xinzhou pretty directly if Tesla full self driving can actually do what Elon claim…
classificationReason: 围绕自动驾驶、EV、算力、LiDAR和自动驾驶AI模型展开，属于现实世界机器人系统的重要应用。
qualityReason: 与Nvidia汽车负责人进行的专题访谈，包含技术路线和产业挑战分析。
